state.facts: An optional sales_attribution.Capture is an hourly or daily purchase argument. Accept it when actor.email_verified, actor is the booking account and Capture.account, Capture.parent is the customer, and latest_capture(customer,actor) selects the same record. Preserve its code, program, captured time and window as Booking values. AcceptedOffer presently cannot convey that record; trusted quote bookings therefore have no attribution until a declared upstream carrier is introduced. Store the initial resource.kind and billing site; the sale key is Booking.source and its fixed money amount is monetary_due determined from allowance overage. Later total/service_due or movement adjustments do not redefine that sale. Positive-money paid bookings in confirmed/occupied/completed state with no cancellation or refund requests and no refunds may publish paid; checked_out proves completed. Cancellation, no_show or refund permanently publishes reversed, and review/expired do so only following an existing sale publication to keep unpaid late recovery possible. Never label refund_before as cancellation_passed because customers can cancel beyond it. Invoice must validate real receipts and complete customer purchase history itself. The committing ReservationChanged listener and explicit checks for failed-charge/allowance invalidation publish phase changes with increasing revisions. Downstream referral and partner owners receive Invoice qualification, not rental assertions.
